messages:
Elaine H: Quick design check — I pushed a new prototype for the embeddings preview density controls. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/embeddings-preview
Max C: Nice, saw it. First thought: the density slider feels like it affects both row density and snippet length. Can we split those?
Juno: Agree. Sliders controlling two orthogonal things = confusing. Maybe 'Row density' + 'Preview length' separately.
Samira: Accessibility nit: color contrast on the active row highlight is only AA at 18pt. It fails at smaller sizes. We should bump it or add a border.
Elaine H: Good catch. I'll raise contrast. Also thinking about default state — should it be 'compact' or 'comfortable' for new users?
Austin: From support tickets, users expect compact for large datasets. Default to compact, but put a tooltip 'Try comfortable for readability'.
Max C: Copy tweak on export CTA: currently 'Export vectors' — lean toward 'Download vectors (CSV)' to set expectation about format.
Samira: Also add aria-label on the export menu: `aria-label="Export vectors and metadata"`. Right now screen reader reads 'button' only.
Elaine H: I'll update copy and aria. Also re: keyboard nav — tab order breaks once the inspector drawer opens.
Juno: Repro: open preview -> press Tab -> focus jumps behind overlay. Looks like focus trap isn't applied to the drawer.
Elaine H: Filed a small bug in the ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/EMB-412 — attaching a quick snippet of the focus trap I used:
```
// Trap focus inside drawer
const previous = document.activeElement;
trapFocus(drawerEl);
onClose(() => { releaseFocus(); previous.focus(); });
```
Max C: For the relevance table, sorting column should persist across sessions if user toggles 'remember table settings'. Add a small toast confirmation 'Settings saved' when toggled.
Samira: Voiceover notes: When a row is selected for rerank, announce 'Row X selected, score Y, actions menu collapsed'. Right now it says only 'selected'.
Austin: UX question: should 'rerank' live as a toolbar action or per-row? We have both in the prototype.
Elaine H: Performance concern — per-row actions add DOM weight for 2k rows. Let's keep primary rerank in toolbar and lazy-render per-row actions on hover.
Juno: Lazy-rendering is fine, but keyboard users need access. Ensure actions are reachable via row context menu `Shift+F10`.
Samira: Also include an option 'Export relevance log' in the export modal — helpful for debugging model regressions.
Elaine H: Cool. Plan: I'll update Figma with split sliders, higher contrast token, export copy, ARIA labels, focus trap fix, and add a new 'remember table settings' toggle. I'll post updates by EOD.
design-bot: Reminder: design critique scheduled 2026-02-12 11:00 PST — thread pinned :pushpin:
Max C: Thanks all — will review EOD and test keyboard flows.
Austin: I can run contrast checks tomorrow morning and return results. :mag:
Elaine H: Thanks team :heart:
